n = int(input())

def equal(a, b):
    for i in range(5):
        if a[i] != b[i]:
            return False
    return True

def dot(a, b):
    res = 0
    for i in range(5):
        res += a[i]*b[i]
    return res > 0

if n <= 11:
    points = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(n)]
    vectors = [[[points[j][k] - points[i][k] for k in range(5)] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    remove_set = set()

    for i in range(n):
        flag = False
        for j in range(n):
            for k in range(n):
                if i != j and i != k:
                    if not equal(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]) and dot(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]):
                        remove_set.add(i + 1)
                        flag = True
                        break
            if flag:
                break

    print(n - len(remove_set))
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if i not in remove_set:
            print(i)
else:
    print(0)
